about: Ask the KHDA chatbot about schools, or book a one-to-one consultation if you are an Emirati parent.
note: Requirements read from the official KHDA service page on the checked date. KHDA fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: All parents in Dubai can use the chatbot
Face-to-face or online consultations are for Emirati parents only
documents: Emirates ID and the child's school details to book a consultation
